verdict.rationale: E2B's pricing page documents a concurrency limit of up to 100 concurrently running sandboxes alongside session-length limits (24h Pro / 1h Base). The CLI supports fleet-level operations such as listing running and paused sandboxes and shutting down all running sandboxes at once. Missing for 10: documented paths or tiers beyond 100 concurrent sandboxes, sandbox-creation rate limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of behavior at large fleet scale.
